visualize_3d_keypoints_on_video: overlay 3D hand keypoints onto rectified exo camera video frames and export as MP4
run_cli_visualization: run the CLI tool to visualize AssemblyHands 3D joint annotations on video with configurable cameras
render_multi_camera_view: render side-by-side visualization of 3D keypoints across multiple exo camera views
project_world_to_pixel: project world-coordinate 3D joints to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics and extrinsics
export_visualization_video: export the annotated visualization frames as an H.264 encoded MP4 video file
